title: Umthwali Wezibonakaliso Eziyisishiyagalolunye
intro: Umuntu othile wavuka kusukela ekuqaleni okuphansi kakhulu, enekusasa elibhalwe ngentando kaNkulunkulu. Efihliwe ebuntwaneni futhi ekhuliswe ngaphakathi kwezindonga zombusi owayefuna ukubhubhisa abantu bakhe, lo mphefumulo wagcina ubizelwe umsebenzi omkhulu. Behlonyiswe ngokholo nentonga yomalusi ethobekile, bema phambi kombusi onamandla kunabo bonke besikhathi futhi bacela inkululeko kulabo ababegqilaziwe. Umhlaba ngokwawo wawubonakala uhamba ngokuyala kwabo - amanzi ahlukana, amazulu akhuluma, futhi umbuso wawa.
clues: Izinsuku zami zokuqala zaziphawulwa ukwesaba — izinsana ezinjengami zazizingelwa ekuzalweni ngumbusi ongenaluzwela owayesaba ikusasa.
Ngasindiswa ngamanzi futhi ngakhulela esigodlweni sombusi owayefuna ukungibhubhisa.
Ngabaleka ezweni lakithi ngemva kwesigameko esingazelelwe, ngaba umalusi othobekile ezweni elikude.
Ngabuya ukuyobhekana nalowo mbusi onamandla ngentonga elula nomyalezo ocacile, ngifuna inkululeko yabantu bakithi.
Ngahlukanisa amanzi amaningi kulabo ababengilandela, futhi ngabuka lawo manzi egwinya isitha sami sonke.
Ngakhwela intaba engcwele ukuze ngithole isiqondiso saphezulu esivela ku-Allah, futhi ngaphiwa izimpawu ezicacile eziyisishiyagalolunye njengobufakazi beqiniso.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ تِسْعَ ءَايَـٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍۢ ۖ فَسْـَٔلْ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِذْ جَآءَهُمْ فَقَالَ لَهُۥ فِرْعَوْنُ إِنِّى لَأَظُنُّكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ مَسْحُورًۭا
verse: And We had certainly given Moses nine evident signs, so ask the Children of Israel [about] when he came to them and Pharaoh said to him, "Indeed I think, O Moses, that you are affected by magic." (17:101)
